proposal.reason: Main change is review-routing policy/automation behavior, owned by workflow: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds typed withdrawal fallback (withdraw_review_requests, pending_review_requests) and updates classification freshness/fingerprinting rules; .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py aligns gate freshness checks to PR head/target; .github/workflows/review-routing.yml changes edited-event routing conditions; and .github/scripts/reviewer_api.py adds GraphQL error/API support used by routing. These are substantive reviewer assignment/approval workflow semantics, not PCCL runtime module behavior or CI test orchestration.
